messages:
maya: Heads-up: drafting the release notes for the upcoming SDK snippet changes and anchor fixes. Need owners for snippet updates and a collection of known issues. PR #5821 has some sample API changes. Anyone own snippet migration?
sam: I'll take the Python examples. Can you point to which files need changes?
maya: Thanks. The list: docs/sdk/python/quickstart.md, docs/guides/auth.md (code sample using old init). Also a couple of anchor links in whats-new page — they break after the title refactor.
kevin: I can handle the anchor fixes + linkcheck. Quick question: do we prefer to update snippets to new client API or keep both (legacy + new) with note?
alex: Linkcheck found 6 broken anchors: /whats-new#streaming, /guides/embeddings#streaming-deprecation, /sdk#init-pattern
sam: Let's migrate Python to new client. I'll add a short note in the changelog 'Python SDK: updated client init; legacy alias kept for one release'.
maya: Good. Sam, add unit sample for streaming fallback. Example snippet to add: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate('hello')
print(resp.text)
```
sam: Added in PR #5840 — needs review from eng-runtime for behavior note.
kevin: I pushed anchor fixes in docs PR #5843. Also updated redirects in netlify config.
maya: Known issues to call out: embeddings streaming deprecation causes partial payloads in some regions (reported by cust-ops), and SDK 0.9.3 has minor parameter rename (max_len -> max_tokens). Add both to the 'known_issues' block.
alex: Noted. Tagging: @eng-runtime, @platform-qa for verification. (automated)
platform-qa: I'll verify the max_tokens behavior on Dedicated next week.
sam: Requesting quick review: @leo from SDK please confirm snippet correctness.
leo: LGTM for the Python snippet, but change client init to `Redwood()` — we renamed the class in v1.0. I'll open a tiny PR to tweak.
maya: Okay — plan: Sam updates Python examples, Leo adjusts to class rename, Kevin merges anchor fixes. I'll prepare the whatsnew blurb and checklist. ETA EOD Friday.
sam: :thumbsup: will do. Adding a small note in the whatsnew: 'Improved snippet parity across SDKs; see migration guide'
kevin: :shipit: once CI passes. Also added a short test to linkcheck CI to detect anchor regressions.
maya: Great, closing loop — tracking PRs: #5821 (changelog draft), #5840 (py snippets), #5843 (anchors), #5849 (leo tweak). I'll publish changelog draft for review tomorrow.
